text:
Type: hopscotch kids' play rug
Use: playing hopscotch and floor games; kids' room, playroom, nursery
Style: contemporary, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: short printed low pile, smooth surface
Colors: medium cool grey, white, red, yellow, green and blue numbers
Shape: rectangular, flat, chalk-style hopscotch squares running lengthwise with bright hand-drawn numbers, compact
Feel: playful, cheerful, active, fun
Goes with: white or light wood kids' furniture, bright accents, grey walls; children's bedrooms and playrooms

product.name: HEMMAHOS
product.description: Playing hopscotch on one or two legs helps your child develop both motor and balance skills.
